blocks.text:
The View is the widget that displays the model data and allows the user to interact
with it. The View can show all of the model's columns, or just some, and it can show
them in various ways.
blocks.zh: 视图（View）是显示模型数据并允许用户与之交互的控件。视图可以显示模型的全部列，也可以只显示部分列，并能以多种方式呈现。

blocks.text:
An important requirement for views (especially views of long lists) is that they need
to know which items are not visible so they can be recycled. Views achieve that by
implementing the `Scrollable` interface and expecting
to be placed directly into a `ScrolledWindow`.
blocks.zh: 视图（尤其是长列表视图）的一个重要需求是：必须知道哪些条目当前不可见，以便回收复用。视图通过实现 `Scrollable` 接口做到这一点，并期望被直接放进 `ScrolledWindow` 中。

blocks.text: There are different view widgets to choose from.
blocks.zh: 有多种视图控件可供选择。

blocks.text: ListView
The `ListView` shows a 1-dimensional list with one column.
blocks.zh: `ListView` 显示带单列的一维列表。
